uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

2228-4279-6578.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-4279-6578.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-4279-6578.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

222-527-647-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-647-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2161-2390-6191.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2161-2390-6191.description:
Gain life.
Scion of the Swarm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-728-2210-2459.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Mirrormade trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Mirrormade.
Repeat.

2292-5035-5104.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
2292-5035-5104.notes: It's recommended to pay as much life as possible to maximize the amount of lifeloss. If an opponent happens to pay life during casting Plague of Vermin, those additional Rats can also be sacrificed.

2103-4064-7722.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Abuelo.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

855-3099-4762-7267.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Corpsejack Menace and Michelangelo.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

413-772-3175.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

206-864-1312-2034-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

2511-4559-7096-7306.easyPrerequisites: You've had two or more lands enter this turn.
2511-4559-7096-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2511-4559-7096-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

57-2341-4359-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
57-2341-4359-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-4907-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tatterkite
When Tatterkite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

856-3263-5226-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-4377-4423-6927.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-4377-4423-6927.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Damage Control Crew.
When Damage Control Crew and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Damage Control Crew trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

2173-2292-5220-5708.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

147-6475-6798.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

891-2386-5220-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Mortuary and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant from your library onto the battlefield.
When Boonweaver Giant enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1
Repeat.

1818-2919-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-2919-4186.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-3951-4192-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
2557-3951-4192-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1251-1270-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2493-4050-4871-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
2493-4050-4871-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Archaeomancer and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Archaeomancer, adding {4}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

397-1496-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-1496-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1170-1477-5006--23.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Lurrus this turn.
1170-1477-5006--23.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact cast in step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.

2061-2493-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Warp each turn.
2061-2493-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
When the Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-4279-5708.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4279-5708.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

1987-2187-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-2187-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Possessed Skaab and Peregrine Drake.
When Possessed Skaab and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1987-2187-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

1912-2416-4131.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
1912-2416-4131.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Cast Rise and Shine by paying {1}{U}, making Basalt Monolith a 0/0 artifact creature and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

1850-4138-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Radiant Fountain from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Radiant Fountain, triggering it and Fastbond.
Resolve the Radiant Fountain trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Activate Radiant Fountain by tapping it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

245-3525-4152.notablePrerequisites:
Undercity Scrounger does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has died this turn.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Undercity Scrounger.
245-3525-4152.description:
Activate Undercity Scrounger by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Undercity Scrounger.
Repeat.

1247-3430-4289.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
1247-3430-4289.description:
Activate Pili-Pala using Paradise Mantle's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Pili-Pala's other ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding three mana of any one color.
Repeat.
